development_primary_metric: mean final cash against frozen E18 V4D on the same seed/seat as E19 V48
development_threshold: E20 mean cash >= E19 mean cash; complete seasons; exact 7-7-2 and no verified animal losses
tournament_design: three frozen models, all three pairings, both seats, 7 seeds, 42 full-season games
selection: freeze selected standalone E20 bundle after the development gate; no tuning on tournament results
report_standard: V4.1, 22 daily KPI, per-pair medians and min-max with reconciled engine ledger
